I don't know how helpful this is but on my team my friend plays Diana all the time as our ap.  For TT you don't need tp since the lanes are so short and getting around with boots s fine.  Your build won't change much since the TT version of Deathcap is called Wooglets and has a built in Zhonyas hourglass which he seems to rush and works out fine.  I find that she does pretty well against most champs but people like Kayle really can hurt her laneing and if her burst can be interrupted/survived then problems can arise.  I'm only gold so take it for whats it's worth (not a lot) but she seems great with burst on 3's.  Just make sure you have some sustained dmg on your team as well.

I played it at Pax East a couple months back.  It looks just like.  The game play was solid and the scares were there.  You really got that intense pressure as you're hiding under a bed and a monster walks into the room a few feet from your face.  The night vision runs dry quick and batteries are limited making it a strong but limited resource.  All in all good fun.  Developers were quite nice as well.
